thread:
Nia: hey all, Nia (eng) here ":wave:". First week underway but I'm blocked: can't create a GCP service account or provision a small sandbox project in us-central1. gcloud errors with `PermissionDenied: 403 The caller does not have permission to access 'serviceAccounts.create'`. Also tried to list billing accounts and got empty list. Who's the right owner for onboarding sandbox + service account + billing link?

Jasper-Infra: welcome Nia! For new sandboxes infra creates a project under the ENG-Onboarding folder and links the ENG-Playground billing acct. Sounds like your Okta role mapping didn't include the `roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin` permission. I'll loop cloud-ops.

cloud-ops: @Nia we handle the project + quotas. Please confirm: desired project-id prefix, whether you need a VPC with private Google access, and which APIs (iam, compute, gke, secretmanager). Also any regional constraints (us-central1 only?) because org policy restricts some regions for prod data.

Nia: prefer project-id `nia-sbox-01`. Need iam, compute, secretmanager, pubsub. VPC yes, we need NAT egress to us-east4 for some downstream services. No EU data.

billing-bot: Billing link request created: CL-9001. Requester: Nia. Billing account: ENG-Playground. Status: pending approval from finance.

Jasper-Infra: FYI for AWS cross-account access (if you need the assume-role), we require you to be in the `redwood-engineers` Okta group so the AWS role trust can map your SAML principal. If you aren't in that group, ping @Lena-SRE to add you.

Lena-SRE: added Nia to redwood-engineers group and updated the Okta app assertion mapping. For verification, can you run `aws sts get-caller-identity` then try `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/Redwood-Engineer --role-session-name nia-test` and paste output if it fails?

cloud-ops: created infra ticket INF-11223 to make the project `nia-sbox-01`, enable requested APIs, create a service account `nia-dev-sa` with roles `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser,roles/storage.objectViewer`, and configure a small VPC with a NAT. I'll set a soft quota for CPUs (4) in us-central1. ETA ~4 hours once billing link is approved.

Nia: thanks! Quick Q: how can I confirm the service account key or workload identity is set up? I prefer workload identity but okay with a short-lived key for initial tests.

cloud-ops: we'll prefer workload identity for security. Steps once the project exists: 1) Create GKE/GCE workload identity pool mapping, 2) bind the KSA to the GSA: `kubectl annotate serviceaccount default iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account=nia-dev-sa@nia-sbox-01.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and then test with `gcloud auth login` + `gcloud auth print-identity-token --audiences=...`. If you need a temporary JSON key for local dev we can create one scoped to 24h; ask in the ticket.

Jasper-Infra: notes for quotas: if you hit CPU or VPC quota issues later, open INF ticket referencing INF-11223 and we can request increases. Also FYI org policy blocks project creation through self-serve (so the `gcloud projects create` path won't work until infra does it).

billing-bot: CL-9001 approved by finance. Billing linked to ENG-Playground.

cloud-ops: billing linked and INF-11223 updated. Proceeding to create project and SA now.

infra-bot: INF-11223 updated: Project `nia-sbox-01` created under folder 123456789012. Service account `nia-dev-sa@nia-sbox-01.iam.gserviceaccount.com` created. VPC `nia-sbox-vpc` with NAT configured. Enabled APIs: iam.googleapis.com, compute.googleapis.com, secretmanager.googleapis.com, pubsub.googleapis.com.

Nia: tried `gcloud iam service-accounts list --project=nia-sbox-01` and I see the SA. Also `gcloud projects get-iam-policy nia-sbox-01` shows me `roles/owner`? I only expect editor-type perms for the sandbox.

cloud-ops: We temporarily added you to `roles/owner` on the project for initial setup, will drop to `roles/editor` after you verify your workflows. Please confirm what you need to do and we'll tighten perms.

Nia: ok verified creating a Compute instance and pushing a secret to Secret Manager works. All good. Please drop owner perms when convenient. Thanks everyone! :tada:"
